description: Hover/keyboard focus on a first-level item card raises that item's incoming user->item status edge above all cards (zIndex above CARD_Z_INDEX 2), thickens it, and dims every other edge (status ~0.25, reference ~0.12); cleared on leave/blur. Pure emphasizeEdges helper + stable-context hover/focus state in CanvasSurface + memoized edge restyle; no layout, position or refit dependency; raised edge has pointer-events none. Independent of FEAT-002 in behavior, but FEAT-002 edits the same AccessGraphCanvas.tsx, so this goes first. Includes creating the temporary real-browser harness and running assertions H1-a..H1-g.
steps: Read plan.md (D1, D2, D8, steps 1-3, 9-10 and the H1 protocol) and context.json first.
In src/graph/buildAccessScene.ts export `CARD_Z_INDEX = 2` and use it for node `zIndex` (output must stay identical; golden tests in buildAccessScene.test.ts must pass).

Create src/graph/emphasizeEdges.ts exporting EMPHASIS_EDGE_Z_INDEX (10), EMPHASIS_STROKE_WIDTH (3.5), DIM_STATUS_OPACITY (0.25), DIM_REFERENCE_OPACITY (0.12) and pure emphasizeEdges(edges, focusedNodeId): returns the same array when focusedNodeId is null or has no incoming edge with data.reviewStatus; otherwise new edge objects: focused edge gets zIndex, thicker strokeWidth, interactionWidth 0, className + ' vc-graph-edge-emphasized'; other status edges style.opacity 0.25; reference edges style.opacity 0.12; no mutation.

Create src/graph/emphasizeEdges.test.ts with the pure cases listed in plan.md (identity cases, z-index > CARD_Z_INDEX, widths, dimming, no mutation, determinism, each kind in LR and TB through real buildAccessScene + statusGraph, withoutReference scene, return-to-baseline).

Create src/graph/EmphasisContext.ts (createContext with no-op default {setHover,setFocus}). In src/graph/AccessNode.tsx take `id` from NodeProps and add onMouseEnter/onMouseLeave/onFocus/onBlur on the drill-down <article> for first-level cards only (kind !== 'user' && !data.reference && !data.interactive); leave markup, aria, NodeTooltip and StatusIcon untouched; blur/leave use functional updates (cur => cur === id ? null : cur).

In src/graph/AccessGraphCanvas.tsx CanvasSurface: add hoverId/focusId state, a useMemo(() => ({setHover:setHoverId,setFocus:setFocusId}), []) provider around the ReactFlow subtree, clear both on sceneKey (`${selectedUserId}|${showReference}|${rankdir}`) change via the 'adjust state during render' pattern, emphasisId = hoverId ?? focusId, displayEdges = useMemo(() => emphasizeEdges(scene.edges, inDrilldown ? emphasisId : null), [scene.edges, emphasisId, inDrilldown]) passed as edges. Do NOT touch the scene memo deps or FitOnSceneChange fitKey/deps.
In src/graph/AccessGraph.css add the .vc-graph-edge-emphasized pointer-events:none !important rule (edge and descendants). No colors, rings, icons or legend changes.

Create src/graph/AccessGraphCanvas.emphasis.test.tsx (ReactFlow wrapper mock recording the edges/nodes props; fitView/setViewport spies; cases in plan.md: hover, focus/blur, reference node no-op, hover+focus precedence, hidden mode, TB, no fitView/setViewport calls on hover, node positions and nodes prop unchanged, stale emphasis cleared on user/reference/layout change, tooltip coexistence). Per-instance rect stubs only, never Element.prototype.
Run npm run build, npm run lint, npm test (re-run once if only src/state/useProvenance.test.ts fails). Commit specific files by name with `git -C <worktree> commit`; do not push.

Real-browser harness (TEMPORARY, never committed): write graph-harness.html, src/test/graph-harness.tsx (imports @xyflow/react/dist/style.css, ./graph/tokens.css via ../graph/tokens.css, ../index.css in main.tsx order; fixtures `standard` = buildFixtureGraph() Alice Adams and `dense` = 25-first-level-item 'Amos Cunningham' built with statusGraph rows as described in plan.md) and harness-driver.mjs; save copies under /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/hover-and-zoom/harness/. `npm install --no-save puppeteer-core@23`. Start Vite on 5199 (CLI first; JS API createServer with the project vite.config.ts if the shell refuses to background it).

Run H1-a..H1-g over fixture x {1700x1000, 1000x700} x reference shown/hidden x LR/TB x minimap on/off, taking screenshots into /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/hover-and-zoom/ and LOOKING at each with read_file. H1-c (pixel paint check) decides whether the raised edge truly paints over cards; if not, implement the D8 ViewportPortal fallback. Fix defects, re-run, re-run gates, recommit.

Delete graph-harness.html, src/test/graph-harness.tsx, harness-driver.mjs from the worktree (copies stay in the artifacts harness/ dir); keep node_modules puppeteer for FEAT-002 or run `npm ci --ignore-scripts`. Confirm `git -C <worktree> status --short` shows nothing untracked from the harness.

Write /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.agents/tasks/hover-and-zoom/verification.md section 'Change 1 (hover/focus)': matrix, per-assertion pass/fail counts, screenshot list with what each shows, the D8 paint-check result, gates output.
acceptance_criteria: `npx vitest run src/graph/emphasizeEdges.test.ts src/graph/AccessGraphCanvas.emphasis.test.tsx src/graph/buildAccessScene.test.ts` passes (golden shown-mode positions unchanged).

In real Chrome, for every first-level card in every scenario of the matrix, hovering or Tab-focusing it yields exactly one .vc-graph-edge-emphasized edge (its incoming status edge) painted over crossed cards (pixel check), thicker, with all other edges dimmed; leaving/blurring restores edge classes/styles string-identically.
In real Chrome hovering at the card border/center never flickers (emphasis stable for 500 ms) and elementFromPoint stays inside the card.
Hovering does not change any node transform or the viewport transform and triggers no fit; hovering a reference-only node changes nothing; NodeTooltip still opens on hover and focus.
npm run build exit 0, npm run lint clean, npm test green (useProvenance flake re-run once at most); package.json and package-lock.json untouched; no harness files committed.
verification: npm run lint (after harness files are deleted)
Real-browser harness H1 run: driver JSON summary shows 0 failures; screenshots h1-*.png saved in the artifacts dir and viewed
git -C /Users/scott.fehrman/Documents/Projects/SailPoint/ui-plugins-apps/visual-certs/.worktrees/hover-and-zoom status --short shows no harness files and no package.json/package-lock.json changes
findings: Committed 4e6fe8e on feature/graph-hover-and-readable-zoom. Constants: CARD_Z_INDEX=2 (buildAccessScene), EMPHASIS_EDGE_Z_INDEX=10, EMPHASIS_STROKE_WIDTH=3.5, DIM_STATUS_OPACITY=0.25, DIM_REFERENCE_OPACITY=0.12 (emphasizeEdges.ts). CanvasSurface now has hoverId/focusId state, EmphasisContext provider around <ReactFlow>, displayEdges passed as edges; FitOnSceneChange and scene memo untouched, so FEAT-002 edits FitOnSceneChange/CanvasSurface props freely (the <ReactFlow> JSX is wrapped in <EmphasisContext.Provider> and NOT re-indented, keep that in mind when editing). D8: raised edge IS painted over crossed cards in real Chrome (edge groups are per-zIndex <svg style=z-index:N> siblings of the node layer in .react-flow__viewport; nodes z 2, raised edge 10); pixel match 100% hover vs 0% baseline; ViewportPortal fallback NOT needed. H1 full matrix (32 scenarios, 440 hover-tested cards, 9606 checks): 1 failure = dense 1700x1000 shown LR map-off Entitlement 03 at minZoom 0.15 where the 3.5px stroke is 0.5 screen px (85% vs 90% sub-pixel threshold); passes at readable zoom (supplemental zoomin runs 0 failures). 40 dense cards are off-canvas / under overlays at 0.15 and could not be hovered (focus/Tab still pass) - exactly the long-list problem FEAT-002 fixes; after FEAT-002 re-run H1 to confirm 0 failures. HARNESS for FEAT-002: sources in .agents/tasks/hover-and-zoom/harness/ (graph-harness.html -> worktree root, graph-harness.tsx -> src/test/, harness-driver.mjs -> worktree root). node_modules/puppeteer-core@23 is installed (--no-save) in the worktree. Vite cannot be backgrounded from the shell tool, the driver starts it itself via createServer (port 5199, https, project vite.config.ts). Run: `node harness-driver.mjs --mode=h1 [--fixtures=standard,dense --viewports=1700x1000,1000x700 --refs=shown,hidden --dirs=LR,TB --maps=on,off --zoomin=N --tag=x]`; full run ~20 min so run it with nohup in the background and poll the log (shell tool has a 30 min cap but blocks); summary JSON goes to the artifacts dir as h1-summary-<tag>.json. `--mode=explore` dumps DOM facts. The driver injects window.H helpers (cards(), edgeInfo(), settle(), zoom(), crossed(), improvedFraction(), ...) reusable for Z1/Z2: drill in by clicking [aria-label='Show access for Amos Cunningham'|'Alice Adams'], toggles via button[aria-label='Hide reference nodes and links' | 'Layout: vertical' | 'Hide minimap']. Remember to cp the three files in, run, and delete them again before lint/commit (git status must stay clean). GOTCHAS: dev-server CSP blocks fetch('data:') (decode PNG with atob+Blob); tooltip is a body portal that covers edge samples (exclude its rect); after a real Tab traversal Chrome leaves an SVG focus ring on the last edge (blur before screenshots) and React Flow may pan to focused nodes (take screenshots before the Tab section); edges are tabbable (tabindex 0) as are node wrappers, so the Tab budget must be 2*nodes+edges+30; dense fixture at 1700x1000 puts cards at y<24 (outside the canvas) at minZoom 0.15, hover-test only cards whose center/left/top probes pass elementFromPoint. Evidence PNGs and verification.md 'Change 1' section are in .agents/tasks/hover-and-zoom/.
